title: Sales Order Field Provenance
purpose: Explain where important sales-order values come from, what can override them, what happens with reference documents, and which downstream controls consume them.
mental_model: Do not ask only where a field is configured. Ask who owns the value in this document.
Separate master-data copy, procedure determination, runtime derivation, manual override, and predecessor copy.
A value copied from a predecessor can intentionally differ from today's master data.

fields.precedence_or_rule: The partner procedure defines allowed and mandatory functions and source control. Master relationships provide candidate partners.
fields.manual_override: Can be restricted or allowed by partner-function settings.
fields.reference_behavior: Reference processing can preserve partner context from the preceding document depending on document and copy rules.
fields.redetermination: Changing partner context is a trigger to re-check dependent shipping, billing, credit, and output assumptions.

fields.precedence_or_rule: For a new document without reference, payment terms are copied from the relevant payer master data. Header data then applies to items unless the process allows a deviation.
fields.manual_override: Document values can be changed when the process and field control allow it.
fields.reference_behavior: When a new document is created with reference, the predecessor header can supply the old payment terms even if master data changed later.
fields.redetermination: Do not assume a payer-master change will update an already copied reference chain.

fields.precedence_or_rule: Incoterms are copied into the sales document from sales-area master context and normally propagate from header to items.
fields.manual_override: A transaction-specific value can be maintained when field control permits it.
fields.reference_behavior: Reference creation can copy the predecessor value instead of reading the latest master data again.
fields.redetermination: Treat Incoterms as copied business context unless a process explicitly redetermines them.

fields.precedence_or_rule: For values maintained in a customer-material record, that customer-specific record can take priority over generic customer or product data.
fields.manual_override: Transaction data can still be changed when the field is open for entry.
fields.reference_behavior: Referenced items may carry copied predecessor values; a newly entered item reads current master context.
fields.redetermination: Re-check customer-material records when the sold-to, sales area, or entered customer material changes.

fields.precedence_or_rule: Weights, descriptions, and other item attributes are copied from the product master for a newly entered item. Material determination can replace the product before downstream controls run.
fields.manual_override: Some copied item values are changeable; core product identity follows document and substitution controls.
fields.reference_behavior: A referenced item can keep predecessor values while a new item in the same target document reads current master data.
fields.redetermination: A material change can alter item category, plant, ATP, pricing, and tax context.

fields.precedence_or_rule: When both are maintained, the sales-document-type shipping condition is the stronger control in the existing mechanism model.
fields.manual_override: Treat manual changes as process-specific; first prove the configured source.
fields.reference_behavior: In a reference chain, inspect whether the value was copied before assuming current master data won.
fields.redetermination: A changed shipping condition can change shipping point and route.

fields.precedence_or_rule: Plant is a runtime logistics result. Its exact source should be proven through the plant mechanism instead of inferred from one master record.
fields.manual_override: A manual plant change is possible in many order scenarios but creates a new logistics context that must be checked downstream.
fields.reference_behavior: Copied predecessor context can preserve a plant that differs from today's default.
fields.redetermination: A plant change requires re-checking shipping point, route, scheduling, ATP, and intercompany or legal context where relevant.

fields.precedence_or_rule: The text determination access sequence searches configured sources in order for each text type.
fields.manual_override: Texts can be manually maintained according to text control.
fields.reference_behavior: A text procedure can copy predecessor text or search master sources. This distinction matters when old text survives into a follow-on document.
fields.redetermination: Trace text type, procedure, access sequence, and source rather than editing the output form.

fields.precedence_or_rule: Standard derivation commonly inherits the profit center from the product; some sales scenarios support broader flexible derivation. A controlling object can have stronger accounting meaning.
fields.manual_override: Treat changes as controlled financial derivation, not a casual sales-field override.
fields.reference_behavior: Once established, profit-center context should remain consistent through follow-on financial processing.
fields.redetermination: If profit center is wrong, prove the original derivation source before correcting billing or FI account logic.

fields.field: Sales area and sales document type for inbound B2B
fields.precedence_or_rule: For supported B2B services, the system can derive sales area, document type, and payment-term discrepancy allowance from inbound message context instead of relying only on a static customer/supplier pair.
fields.manual_override: This is integration-time context determination, not normal interactive order entry.
fields.reference_behavior: Not a predecessor-copy case; the important boundary is message-to-business-context mapping.
fields.redetermination: When inbound mapping changes, retest downstream sales-order controls because a different sales area or document type can select different procedures.
